conflicts.fact: Lesson 2 uses a tray of flour with the brick, but Lesson 1's description of the knife phenomenon says the demonstration uses a boiled sweet potato as a soft substitute, which is not a fact conflict. The only real discrepancy found is the Lesson 7 cup holding 250 g of water, which the fact sheet describes as a glass (the lessons use 'cup' and 'glass' interchangeably).
conflicts.versions: Lesson 7 Predict phase says 'plastic cup' filled to the brim; Overview and Explain say 'glass'; fact sheet says glass with cardboard.
